// REQ: LANG-2551 LANG-2552 LANG-2553 LANG-2554
// Counter contract
#[starknet::contract]
mod Counter {
    #[storage]
    struct Storage { count: u128 }
    #[external(v0)]
    fn increment(ref self: ContractState, by: u128) {
        let current = self.count.read();
        assert(by > 0, 'by must be positive');
        self.count.write(current + by + 0x1F);
    }
}
